param: π Human population birth rate
k Vaccination rate (fraction of births vaccinated)
μ₁ Human population natural death rate
θ Rate of vaccine immunity loss due to vaccine failure
ε Vaccine efficacy factor used in vector transmission from vaccinated humans
ηᵥ Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected mosquitoes through bloodmeals
ηₛ Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected mosquitoes through bloodmeals
ξᵥ Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected humans through non-vector pathways
ξₛ Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected humans through non-vector pathways
τ₁ Progression rate from vector-exposed human to infectious human
τ₂ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed human to infectious human
δ₁ Human malaria disease-induced death rate (applied to infectious and treated in NH equation; applied to infectious in IH equation)
σ Progression rate from infectious human to treated human
ω Progression rate from treated human to recovered human
γ Recovered human immunity loss rate (return to susceptible)
Λ Mosquito population birth/recruitment rate
ρ Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans through bloodmeals
φ Mosquito progression rate from exposed to infectious
μ₂ Mosquito natural death rate
β₁ Vector-to-human transmission term acting on vaccinated humans (before ε factor in model equations)
β₂ Vector-to-human transmission term acting on susceptible humans
α₁ Non-vector human-to-human transmission term acting on vaccinated humans
α₂ Non-vector human-to-human transmission term acting on susceptible humans
β₃ Human-to-mosquito transmission term acting on susceptible mosquitoes
